'''Adar 15 (April 27)'''

==Events==
</noinclude>
*{{ne|998}} - [[Rand al'Thor]] and [[Matrim Cauthon]] arrive at [[Four Kings]] in the evening. At The [[Dancing Cartman]], they are approached by the [[Darkfriend]] [[Howal Gode]]. Rand channels unknowingly - lightning strikes the inn, killing Gode. They escape into the night, with Mat temporarily blinded. Rand dreams, and encounters the dead Gode and [[Ba'alzamon]].
*{{ne|999}} - [[Nynaeve al'Meara]], [[Elayne Trakand]] and [[Egwene al'Vere]] leave the bandits' camp with horses, and board the ''[[Darter]]'' at [[Jurene]], bound for [[Tear]]. Mat Cauthon and [[Thomdril Merrilin]] arrive at [[Aringill]]. They take shelter in the stable of [[The Good Queen]] during a rainstorm, and rescue [[Aludra]] from [[Tammuz]] and his thugs. She gives Mat some fireworks. They ride off towards [[Caemlyn]].
*{{ne|1000}} - [[Tuon Athaem Kore Paendrag]] arrives back in [[Ebou Dar]] and shows [[Zaired Elbar]]'s head to [[Suroth Sabelle Meldarath]]. Suroth is made ''[[da'covale]]'' and given to the [[Deathwatch Guard]]. [[Pevara Tazanovni]] and a party of [[Red Ajah]] [[Traveling|Travel]] to the [[Black Tower]]. [[Mazrim Taim]] gives permission for them to bond [[Asha'man]] as [[Warders]].
